prompt: This report came from FastReport. Make it a working DevExpress report: group the products by the first letter of their name and print that letter in the group header with a DevExpress expression, print Total products: with the number of products in each group, and keep the rest as it is.
notes: Openly licensed (FastReport's MIT demo Groups.frx; NOTICE.md), added 2026-11-10 (the AI accuracy programme, batch AH item 26). A migration in words: the report converted by scripts/model/fastreport.ts still prints FastReport's own syntax in its group header ([[Products.ProductName].Substring(0,1)]) and totals a FastReport Total object that DevExpress has no field for (sumSum([TotalProducts])). The case asks the AI to make both DevExpress, from the file, and to keep the title, the records and the page footer: the existing .repx is the base structure, as the prompt's SOURCE PRECEDENCE says.
